rationale: A's entrance builds cleanly from an empty frame: the headline masks in line by line and the live-ledger code panel slides in beside it, so the hero settles by about 1.3 s with a real product visual. B shows its full headline at 80 ms, blanks it by 509 ms and then re-reveals it letter by letter, which reads as a flash of content. B's hero also leaves the right half empty. B's editorial serif type, stacked cream-and-dark panel transitions and big lime footer wordmark are striking, and its scroll story is as rich as A's (sticky stepper, metric cards, stacked testimonials, pricing). B's hover captures show only a lime surface with no visible control feedback, while A's nav underlines and glowing CTA hovers are clear; both phone layouts are clean.
